title: Learning from Failure: The Riverside Community Clinic Review
instructions: 这是为B2–C1成人学习者设计的综合模拟练习（第49周），主题为“综合模拟一与证据整理”。听力部分为一段真实的会议对话，包含自然插话、纠正和干扰信息；阅读部分为同一场景的后续报告。请先听/读全文，再完成10道题（听力与阅读混合，题型包括单选、填空、匹配/标题和判断正误/未提及）。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。注意：本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试，也不代表任何官方分数。
transcript:
[Meeting room, Riverside Community Clinic. Present: Dr. Maya Chen (facilitator), Tom Baker (senior nurse), Priya Shah (quality lead), and Ben Okafor (junior administrator).]

Maya: Thanks for coming. Today we’re reviewing the medication-error incident from last month. The goal is to understand what happened and what we can change. Tom, can you start with the timeline?

Tom: Sure. On the 14th, a patient was given the wrong dose of a blood thinner. The nurse on duty was experienced, but the shift was short-staffed. The error was caught two hours later during a routine check.

Priya: Sorry to interrupt—was the patient harmed?

Tom: No, thankfully. The patient was monitored and was fine. But we need to learn from it.

Maya: Right. Ben, you looked at the incident report. What stood out?

Ben: The report was filed three days late. That’s a problem because details get forgotten. Also, the form asks for the nurse’s name, but not for the system factors—like workload or interruptions.

Priya: That’s a key point. If we only blame the individual, we miss the bigger picture. I’d suggest we revise the form to include a section on working conditions.

Maya: Good. Tom, what about the training?

Tom: The nurse had completed the online module, but it was six months old. The module doesn’t cover new drug names. So maybe we need shorter, more frequent updates.

Ben: I agree. And we could add a quick team huddle before each shift to review high-risk medications.

Maya: Let’s note that. Priya, you mentioned earlier that other clinics have tried a “no-blame” reporting system. Can you explain?

Priya: Yes. In a no-blame system, staff report errors without fear of punishment. The focus is on learning, not on blaming. But it only works if leadership supports it and if reports are acted on quickly.

Maya: So we need both a culture change and a process change. Tom, how did staff react to the incident?

Tom: Some were anxious. A few worried they’d be punished. But after the manager explained the no-blame approach, people became more open. One nurse said she now feels safer reporting near-misses.

Maya: That’s encouraging. Ben, can you summarize the action points?

Ben: Sure. First, revise the incident form to include system factors. Second, introduce short monthly training updates. Third, pilot a pre-shift huddle for high-risk drugs. Fourth, communicate the no-blame policy clearly to all staff.

Maya: And who will lead each action?

Ben: I can lead the form revision with Priya. Tom can lead the training updates. And the huddle pilot—maybe Priya and I can co-lead.

Priya: That works for me. But we need a timeline. Can we aim to start the pilot next month?

Maya: Yes, let’s set a review meeting in six weeks to check progress. Any other comments?

Tom: Just one. We should also share the learning with the wider network. Other clinics might benefit.

Maya: Agreed. I’ll draft a short summary for the regional meeting. Thanks, everyone. Let’s make sure this becomes a learning opportunity, not just a report.

grammar.title: 复习已发现的高频错误：主谓一致与被动语态
grammar.explanation: 本周围绕“组织如何从失败中学习”的场景，我们重点复查两个影响理解的高频错误：1) 主谓一致——当主语是单数第三人称时，动词要加-s（如 The report was filed）；当主语是复数时，动词用原形（如 Staff report errors）。2) 被动语态——强调动作的承受者时，用 be + 过去分词（如 The error was caught）。注意不要漏掉be动词或过去分词形式错误。请先理解意思，再注意形式。
grammar.example: The error was caught two hours later during a routine check.

options: The nurse report the error yesterday.
The nurse reported the error yesterday.
The nurse reports the error yesterday.
The nurse reporting the error yesterday.
answers: The nurse reported the error yesterday.
questions.explanation: 主语The nurse是单数，且时间yesterday表示过去，因此用过去式reported。
questions.evidence: The nurse reported the error yesterday.

options: The forms was revised last week.
The forms were revised last week.
The forms is revised last week.
The forms been revised last week.
answers: The forms were revised last week.
questions.explanation: 主语The forms是复数，被动语态用were + 过去分词revised。
questions.evidence: The forms were revised last week.

options: Staff is report errors without fear.
questions.explanation: Staff作为集合名词表示复数，动词用原形report。

options: The meeting was schedule for next month.
The meeting was scheduled for next month.
The meeting were scheduled for next month.
The meeting is schedule for next month.
answers: The meeting was scheduled for next month.
questions.explanation: 被动语态需要be + 过去分词，schedule的过去分词是scheduled。
questions.evidence: The meeting was scheduled for next month.

The manager explains the policy clearly.
The manager explaining the policy clearly.
The manager are explain the policy clearly.
answers: The manager explains the policy clearly.
questions.explanation: 主语The manager是单数第三人称，一般现在时动词加-s。
questions.evidence: The manager explains the policy clearly.

questions.explanation: 主语The patients是复数，被动语态用were + 过去分词monitored。

questions.evidence: The team huddle helps reduce errors.
